description: Canonical outcome-type vocabulary for the Outcome360 intelligence projection. A 360 is an intelligence projection over canonical Aether truth — never a competing system of record. This registry names the outcome kinds the measurement plane can attest (each maps to an OutcomeState finality ladder on canonical outcome_facts); it never re-implements measurement facts.

outcomeTypes.name: Access Control Enforced
outcomeTypes.description: An entitlement or access decision was evaluated and enforced correctly (allow/deny matches policy).

outcomeTypes.name: Agent Objective Attainment
outcomeTypes.description: An agent-executed objective/OKR was attained within its declared budget and constraints.

outcomeTypes.name: Agent Task Completion
outcomeTypes.description: An agent-executed task reached its terminal success state with corroborating evidence.

outcomeTypes.name: Campaign Conversion
outcomeTypes.description: A campaign subject completed a target conversion event (signup, purchase, order, closed-won).

outcomeTypes.name: Chargeback Avoidance
outcomeTypes.description: A dispute was resolved in the subject's favor without chargeback loss, or a predicted dispute was prevented.

outcomeTypes.name: Compliance Milestone Met
outcomeTypes.description: A compliance or regulatory milestone (audit, certification, filing, attestation) was met on schedule.

outcomeTypes.name: Engagement Completion
outcomeTypes.description: A product workflow (onboarding, activation, migration) reached its defined completion state.

outcomeTypes.name: Fraud Prevention Hit
outcomeTypes.description: A fraudulent activity was blocked or intercepted before material loss occurred.

outcomeTypes.name: Governance Proposal Passed
outcomeTypes.description: A governance proposal reached quorum and passed according to the governing policy.

outcomeTypes.name: Journey Completion
outcomeTypes.description: A journey reached its terminal converted state (backed by the measurement journey engine).

outcomeTypes.name: On-Chain Settlement Completed
outcomeTypes.description: An on-chain settlement finalized on its target chain with the expected finality.

outcomeTypes.name: Reconciliation Completed
outcomeTypes.description: A ledger or system reconciliation reached zero outstanding variance within the window.

outcomeTypes.name: Retention Window Achieved
outcomeTypes.description: A subject retained engagement past a contractual or product retention window.

outcomeTypes.name: Revenue Attainment
outcomeTypes.description: Recognized revenue attained the declared target within the measurement window.

outcomeTypes.name: Return on Ad Spend Attainment
outcomeTypes.description: Return on ad spend attained the declared target for the campaign or episode.

outcomeTypes.name: SLA Attainment
outcomeTypes.description: A service-level agreement (latency, uptime, response) was met within the measurement window.
